description: The District of Columbia Courts (“Courts” or “DCC”) on behalf of the District of Columbia Court of Appeals (“DCCA” or “Court of Appeals”), in conjunction with the Information Technology Division (ITD) are seeking a qualified contractor to provide two (2) mid-level Quality Assurance (QA) and Software Testers to support the implementation of the Court of Appeals Case Management System, a web-based enterprise application as specified in Section C (Description/Specifications/Work Statement).
